calculation.expression: when lagged(VIX_return_1d > rolling_60d_quantile(VIX_return_1d,0.75)) AND lagged(cross_sectional_stddev(asset_returns_1d) > rolling_60d_quantile(cross_sectional_stddev(asset_returns_1d),0.75)): negative rolling_sum(asset_return_1d,3), cross_sectionally median-centered
calculation.description: During a lagged VIX shock coinciding with unusually high cross-asset dispersion, rank assets by their negative trailing three-day return to capture short-horizon reversal. Signals are median-centered and only use completed daily observations.

metrics.factor_coverage_note: Regime active on 216 dates; conditional signal has broad cross-section (typically 14 of 15 instruments).

validation.regime_notes: Daily and multi-day IC gates pass, but the factor is conditional and has limited active-date history. Regime IC by daily forward return: 2020-22 -0.0952 (12 observations), 2023-24 +0.0894 (11), 2025-26 +0.1110 (15), 2027 +0.2073 (1); interpret early regime estimates cautiously.
